title: How Differential Gear works (BEST Tutorial)
summary: A 1930s Chevrolet training film explaining the principles and development of the differential gear. It builds the idea step by step from first principles to the finished mechanism.
why: HN loves it as an example of old-school instructional film that makes how a differential works fully understandable in clear, simple language.

quote.text: after watching this ancient Chevrolet training video from the 1930's I feel like I completely understand how diffs work
